diagnosis: A note with multiple images could reach the PDF-ready check while one WebView image decode promise had rejected or while an obsolete reference remained in the reference map. The previous readiness check treated either condition as a failure even when all images in the current note were loaded.
changes: Wait for each image decode, then fall back to its load/error events when decode is still pending or rejects.
Determine unresolved references from the images currently present in the note instead of the entire historical source map.
Extend the two-image instrumented regression to await prepareForPrint() and require a ready result.
